description: This file defines the CloudControlApiClient class in the Aws\CloudControlApi namespace, which serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Cloud Control API service. It includes method annotations for various resource management operations such as creating, deleting, getting, and updating resources, both synchronously and asynchronously.
